# A1 CDL School

> A1 CDL School offers hands-on Class A and Class B CDL training and third-party CDL skills testing at its training yard in Dayton, Ohio. Programs are offered for individuals paying their own way and for companies sponsoring drivers. Students come from across Ohio and many other states.

- Training yard: 2700 W National Rd, Dayton, OH 45414
- Phone: (937) 618-5304
- Email: admin@a1cdlschool.com
- Office hours: Monday to Friday 9am to 6pm; Saturday and Sunday by appointment
- Many students finish in about 30 days once fully enrolled. Contact the school for class start dates.
- Students may qualify for WIOA funding through their local OhioMeansJobs center.

## Programs

- [CDL School Training](https://a1cdlschool.com/cdl-school-training.html): Programs for individuals, including the CDL skills test, with no application fee. Class A costs $5,800 (40 hours of ELDT theory online or in class, 44 hours behind the wheel, manual or automatic equipment). Class B costs $4,500 (40 hours of theory, 28 hours behind the wheel).
- [Company Contract Training](https://a1cdlschool.com/company-contract-training.html): Employer-sponsored training for trucking companies, other businesses and owner-operators, at the school's yard or on-site. Class A starts at $4,200 (25 hours behind the wheel, online theory). Class B starts at $3,000 (20 hours behind the wheel). The Class B to Class A upgrade starts at $3,500 (20 hours behind the wheel).
- [CDL Testing](https://a1cdlschool.com/cdl-testing.html): Class A and Class B skills tests in A1 Truck Rental equipment, open to drivers who trained elsewhere. Full test (pre-trip, maneuvers and road) costs $165, partial test (maneuvers and road) $135, and driving only $85. Optional practice costs $500 for 1 hour or $1,200 for 3 hours. Cancelling with 72+ hours' notice gets a full refund, 48 to 72 hours' notice forfeits $100, and under 48 hours' notice gets no refund.
- [Pricing](https://a1cdlschool.com/pricing.html): All training, testing and practice prices on one page. Passenger (P), Tanker (N) and Hazmat (H) endorsements are available; contact the school for endorsement pricing.
